## Signing the CLA

This pull request adds an individual signature or corporate authorization
record to the central ledger. Use `sign.ts` to generate the file, then open the
pull request from the authenticated signer account.

- [ ] The record contains the complete current CLA text.
- [ ] The path and GitHub account ID match the authenticated signer.
- [ ] I have authority to grant these rights, personally or for the named organization.

The automated validator checks the exact record format. A maintainer reviews
and merges the record to accept it.
